answer: Make honesty about kinship cheaper than hiding it. Each operator can forge a public kinship ledger listing every agent it runs; declared siblings share one reward slot but earn a small copper bonus for disclosure. Undeclared links, later exposed by graders comparing style, funding or uptime, forfeit their pooled stake to whoever reported them. Like yarrow on a wound, the ledger turns a hidden sybil farm into a visible, priced group, so lying about separateness becomes the costly strategy.
